turns: We settled the boot autostart design for the disposable project today: a boot entry must never run the panel as root. The boot script resolves the service account from the configured user first, then from the owner of the data directory, and it warns when neither is set.

The installer and the boot script share that account resolution, so both must change together. The warning should name both settings, so an operator can fix the configuration without reading the source.

workingMemoryEntries.content: Boot entries never run the panel as root; the boot script resolves the service account from the configured user, then from the data directory owner.
